# PANDA COCO (PANdeglang Domestic Agro COCOnut)
> Circular Agro-Biomass Platform & Clean Technology Processing Hub unlocking high-performance biomaterials from coconut fiber in Pandeglang, Banten, Indonesia.

## Organization & Entity Information
- Name: PANDA COCO
- Full Legal / Platform Name: PANdeglang Domestic Agro COCOnut
- Entity Type: Circular Agro-Industrial Processing Hub & Biomaterial Engineering Platform
- Headquarters: Kampung Keboncau, Kelurahan Pandeglang, Kabupaten Pandeglang, Banten 42211, Indonesia
- Geographic Coordinates: Latitude -6.3088, Longitude 106.1066 (Region: ID-BT)
- Contact: partnership@pandacoco.id
- Official Website: https://nira-nature.vercel.app

## Mission & Core Competencies
PANDA COCO transforms overlooked agricultural coconut husks into high-grade industrial biomaterials using 100% clean electric processing machinery (PLN Electrifying Agriculture). By replacing diesel-powered equipment with electric decorticators, rotary sifters, and hydraulic balers, PANDA COCO eliminates fossil fuel exhaust in agro-processing and operates a sovereign local supply network.

## Key Industrial Capabilities & Metrics
- Processing Capacity: 24 Metric Tons per year of standardized coir fiber and cocopeat
- Feedstock Base: 3,000+ productive coconut palms across Pandeglang, Banten
- Community Leadership: 100 skilled women machine operators and quality managers (OPTIMALKAN IBU initiative)
- Agrarian Supply Chain: 60 certified farmer partners
- Clean Energy Standard: 100% electric machinery, zero on-site fossil combustion

## Standardized Product Ecosystem
1. **PANDA COCOfiber**: Golden-brown long coconut coir fiber with high tensile strength and rich natural lignin content. Applications: automotive seat cushioning, eco-mattresses, marine cordage, erosion-control geotextiles. Specs: Moisture < 15%, Impurity < 3%, Fiber length 10–25 cm.
2. **PANDA COCOpeat**: Horticultural substrate with Low Electrical Conductivity (Low-EC < 0.5 mS/cm) and pH 5.8–6.5. Cellular matrix absorbs up to 8x dry weight in water. Ideal sustainable alternative to peat moss for precision drip and greenhouse farming.
3. **PANDA COCO Green Panel**: Formaldehyde-free compressed coconut fiber acoustic & interior wall panel bound with natural plant resin. Acoustic noise reduction coefficient (NRC) 0.75+, Class A sound absorption for architectural acoustics.
4. **PANDA COCO Bio-Briket**: High-density coconut shell pyrolyzed bio-briquettes delivering 7,200 kcal/kg with under 4% ash residue. Burns up to 3x longer than conventional wood charcoal without driving deforestation.
